lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: What are you doing, Carol?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: I'm making a shopping list, Tom.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: What do we need?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: We need a lot of things this week.
lines.zh: 这星期我们需要很多东西。

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: I must go to the grocer's.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: We haven't got much tea or coffee,
lines.zh: 我们的茶叶和咖啡不多了，

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: and we haven't got any sugar or jam.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: What about vegetables?

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: I must go to the greengrocer's.
lines.zh: 我还得到蔬菜水果店去一下。

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: We haven't got many tomatoes,

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: but we've got a lot of potatoes.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: I must go to the butcher's, too.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: We need some meat.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: We haven't got any meat at all.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: Have we got any beer and wine?
lines.zh: 我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: No, we haven't.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: And I'm not going to get any!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: I hope that you've got some money.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.en: I haven't got much.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.en: Well, I haven't got much either!
